skybox.noSource: No skybox yet. Generate one or drop an equirectangular panorama.
skybox.testObjectsHint: Puts probe spheres into the sky, to judge the light it gives

material.dropSource: Drop an image from the project to use it as the base colour
material.showSeam: Bring the seams to the middle
material.seamNoSource: Place a base colour to measure
material.originGenerated: Generated by a model — frozen as it came
material.originDerived: Computed from another channel of this material
material.deriveBusy: Compute from {{source}} — another channel is being computed
material.inspectChannelHint: Shows this channel flat, as it is, with no lighting and no relief. A double-click opens its pixels in the Image space.
material.litMaterialHint: Back to the material as rendered, every channel combined
material.supportHint: The shape the material is laid on — click to step to the next one
material.inspectHint: Switches between the lit material and the last channel looked at flat
material.showSeamHint: Shifts the preview by half a width to bring the edges to the middle, where the eye sees them
material.showBackgroundHint: Draws the environment behind the material, instead of only lighting it
material.autoSpinHint: Turns the shape so the material can be judged from every angle
material.frameHint: Puts the camera back where it was when the material opened
material.tilingPreviewHint: Changes the preview only — the exported material is still not repeated
material.previewShapeHint: Changes the shape the preview is laid on, not the material
material.measureSeamHint: Compares the opposite edges of the material to say whether the seam shows
material.deriveHint: Computes this channel from another one rather than from an imported image
